subject: Re: Kickoff: diffusion concept decomposition & bias audits
body:
Hi both,

Status: the decomposition pipeline reproduces on Stable Diffusion. Pseudo-tokens trained per concept reconstruct generated images faithfully, and the qualitative findings hold on our stack — "a composer" decomposes into a handful of specific-individual tokens plus style terms, while abstract concepts like "happiness" mix concrete tokens ("family", "laughter") with abstract ones. Single-image decomposition works and is honestly the best demo material we have.

Audit progress: Katya's methodology scores concepts by how concentrated their decomposition is on protected-attribute or specific-person tokens; a first pass over 200 profession concepts flags 31 for review.

Trade-off: sparsity level matters a lot — at 10 tokens the decompositions are readable but reconstruction suffers; at 50 they reconstruct well but audits get noisy. The June sweep should cover both regimes, which doubles its size; worth confirming the reservation covers it.

Giannis
